reason: At $22k a year, $25 to $30 a month for one supplement is more than I want to spend, and I already forget my vitamins on the counter half the time. Foil sachets also feel like extra packaging waste for something I could get in a bottle for less.
objection: Too much money per month for one mineral, and a sachet a day is more packaging than a bottle. I would be paying extra for the 'on the go' format I do not need at home.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 for 30 days, or a bottle option with the same lab report and dose, so I am not paying for the sachets.
